summary: Independent EvidenceGate review approves TASK-0050 for the narrow workflow-invariant closeout only. The review confirms that BoundedTaskExecutor imports the default-visible TaskHarness adapter entrypoint, component lifecycle documentation no longer leaves the dependency ambiguous, Mode C scorecards expose workflow failure dimensions, real Executor budget normalization is represented as an invariant with targeted coverage, and non-literal plus multi-output output contracts have deterministic coverage. This approval does not approve Mode C defaultization or broad live Mode C stability.

criteria.criterion: The BoundedTaskExecutor to TaskHarness dependency is no longer ambiguous in code imports and component lifecycle documentation.
criteria.notes: Code review confirmed src/ahra/reference_runner/task_harness.py is the default-visible TaskHarness entrypoint, BoundedTaskExecutor imports TaskHarness from that adapter, and component-inventory.json documents the default-visible adapter plus legacy standard_harness compatibility boundary. The implementation still keeps the underlying TaskHarness class in standard_harness.py for compatibility, which the resolution report states as a remaining non-blocking limit rather than a completed extraction.

criteria.criterion: Mode C pilot scorecards include workflow failure dimensions sufficient to distinguish contract, gate, budget, scheduler, provider/runtime, and model-behavior failures.
criteria.notes: real_agent_pilot.py now emits per-run workflow_failure_dimension and scorecard workflow_failure_dimensions with the requested classes: contract, gate, budget, scheduler, provider_runtime, model_behavior, unknown, and none. Targeted tests exercise provider/runtime, model-behavior, scheduler, and budget-related paths; manual code review confirmed contract and gate mappings are present.

criteria.criterion: The real Executor budget normalization invariant is documented or exposed in evidence and has targeted test coverage.
criteria.notes: The real Executor budget invariant is exposed in scorecards as real_executor_budget_invariant and in planner normalization evidence. tests.test_real_agent_pilot includes targeted coverage for real executor profile requirements and Mode C planner/executor budget normalization.

criteria.criterion: Non-literal output resources and multi-output expectedOutputs have deterministic invariant coverage without weakening literal artifact checks.
criteria.notes: bounded_task.py preserves directory resource trailing slashes and only creates exact artifact existence checks for literal file resources. tests.test_node_executor covers multiple literal artifacts and non-literal/directory resources without weakening literal artifact checks.

criteria.criterion: A workflow-invariant resolution report maps each TASK-0049 P1 risk to the implemented mitigation and states any remaining no-go boundary.
criteria.notes: workflow-invariant-resolution.md maps all four TASK-0049 P1 risks to implemented mitigations and states the remaining no-go boundaries: no Mode C defaultization and no broad live Mode C stability approval.

criteria.criterion: Targeted tests, lint, and diff checks pass, or any failure is recorded as a blocker with exact command output.
criteria.notes: Independent verification reran the targeted unittest suite, full test suite, lint, git diff check, task inspect, and manifest hash audit. All passed.

criteria.criterion: Producer moves TASK-0050 only to review; EvidenceGate decides completion.
criteria.notes: Producer left TASK-0050 in review at state_version=3 with lease null and no blockers. The verifier actor is independent from the producer identity; EvidenceGate remains the completion authority.
